svg.aria-label: Where each model pays, measured in D5 on the presenter's Mac after the three dashboards were proven identical, relative only. Redo per order, the order included: embedded about 17 KB (the order 2.6 plus the counter 14.7), counter documents about 5 KB (2.6 plus 2.3), converged about 3.5 KB (2.4 plus 1.2). The order costs the same in all three; the counter write is the difference: embedded rewrites the region's 9.5 KB document, counter documents rewrite a 127-byte JSON document and its etag with a second commit, converged changes one number in a 17-byte row in the order's own commit. Dashboard read for one region: embedded about 0.6 ms, the counter pipeline 0.6 to 0.7 ms, converged about 0.4 ms. The same counts at the same speed: the difference is where the query lives
